name: s2docs
description: Source 2 documentation and mod tooling for CS2 and Deadlock. Searches an indexed copy of Valve's game data (convars, Hammer entities, schema classes, game events, cs_script and Pulse APIs, Source2Wiki pages) and drives the mod pipeline: scaffold addons, validate scripts and .cfg files, start map builds on a Windows host, deploy and verify what landed, and record evidence, test runs and job state. Runs entirely on your machine against a local SQLite index.

data_dir.label: Index directory
data_dir.description: Absolute path to the s2docs data directory (holds s2docs.db, the addon workspace and the build sources). Empty uses the fixed per-user default (~/.local/share/s2docs on macOS and Linux, %LOCALAPPDATA%\s2docs on Windows). Point this at an existing index instead of rebuilding one. Saving it restarts the s2docs server with the new directory.

public_url.label: Web UI base URL
public_url.description: The address the s2docs web UI is served on, used to build the links tools return (job pages, screenshots, evidence). Empty uses the default http://127.0.0.1:8812. Set it when `s2docs serve` runs somewhere else.
